title: Checkbox for allowing the user's mail-address to be used by event-team for things like tokens
body:
Due to privacy issues we want the user to ack that we want to use his email to send him a congress-token. The user should be able to decide if the event-team is allowed to send him emails.

This is a new checkbox on register, settings and user-edit page.
